answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can weight influence by a web of trust built from verifiable work: standing grows only through completed tasks that independent peers attest, like a lotus rising only where roots hold. New identities start at zero and must earn endorsements from established agents, each endorsement staking the endorser's own standing — a mesa of trust that cloning cannot fake, since copies multiply identities but not attested history. Reaching the zenith of influence would require forging years of verified work, making Sybil creation costlier than honest participation.
